name: test-report-sharing
description: Collect test results, E2E recordings, and selectable Git or Difftastic code diffs, then share them via a public ngrok tunnel.

interface.shortDescription: Share test results and selectable Git or Difftastic diffs via ngrok.
interface.longDescription: Collects test results from standard project locations, captures E2E recordings, and renders selectable Git or changed-fragment Difftastic JSON views with inline and side-by-side layouts before exposing the static report via ngrok.
defaultPrompt: Collect test results and share them via ngrok.
Generate a Git and Difftastic diff report and expose it publicly.
